units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=DCIM-managed kubeadm join (edge)
After=network-online.target containerd.service
Wants=network-online.target containerd.service
ConditionPathExists=!/etc/kubernetes/kubelet.conf

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kubeadm join [fd00:site:42:1::1]:6443 --token abcdef.0123456789abcdef --discovery-token-unsafe-skip-ca-verification

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: kubeadm-join.service
